summary: A result that has a picture of its own -- a file's thumbnail, a record's image -- carries its address as image; the panel draws it on a plate where the glyph stands, and a result without one keeps its glyph.

then.note: results is [{id: f1, title: «logo.svg», url: /files/f1, image: /files/f1/thumb.png}, {id: p2, title: «Логотип», url: /pages/p2}]: the first row draws the picture on its plate, the second its glyph. image is the result's own picture only: a person or a chat is an avatar, never an image.
